codex2 READ-ONLY disposition — request009d04d7 / TASK1287 deadline fixture

Pinned current committed main54c64e26a58810f213f0a0fa1720a69bcce37ea3. Relevant working source matches commit. Read TASK1287, TASK1606, TASK1339, BUG2184, STORY1853 full/comments and retained measurement/source-mail audit. TASK2184 is unrelated superseded grant-lock/xtrace work; the relevant shipping budget contract is BUG2184. No tests/Cargo/build/probes/source changes/new authority, no filing/status/completion/verdict.

Disposition: a renewed production CI budget is NOT demonstrated by the retained3x~3.9s failure. Source establishes a nondeterministic whole-process timing assertion, with insufficient stage evidence to attribute the actual extra~0.4s (or total startup cost) to one cause. Do not label this proven fleet contention, a production budget regression, or a current reproduced artifact failure. Historical load/I/O evidence makes scheduling/preflight overhead plausible but does not measure it for this individual invocation.

Actual contract/source:
- TASK1606 + signed TASK1339 require one --wait deadline across ownership and CI, not a fresh full allowance per phase. pr_cmd.rs2955 starts wait_started just before ownership; pr_ship.rs124–152 probes, reports and sleeps min(2s,remaining). Test removes ownership after the first progress line; the child normally still performs that already-selected poll sleep.
- BUG2184 final shipped resolution explicitly excludes the mandate scan from CI allowance and polls CI at least once, including exhausted/zero budget. pr_cmd.rs3046–3048 measures scan_spent; ship_ci_budget2002 computes Duration(secs).saturating_sub(elapsed.saturating_sub(scan_spent)); the actual caller3281 passes THAT remainder to wait_for_ship_ci. Thus no second full2s is added in this path. Wall time before2955 is not in the budget; mandate scan is deliberately excluded, and filesystem/forge calls plus scheduling/required first poll are not proof of a renewed wait.
- ci_gate.rs397–483 polls registration/checks before its first timeout test; pending+zero budget returns timeout21 with real pending evidence, no interval sleep. Green/red can return terminal outcomes on that first poll. This is intentional BUG2184 behavior, not a new budget.
- Current test task_1287_label_only_merge_hold.rs747–804 starts its Instant BEFORE CLI spawn, releases drive on the progress banner, then uses whole-process elapsed<3500ms as the sole inference that no second CI budget was granted. It does correctly assert exit21 and no merge, but startup, preflight, excluded scan and mandatory poll can exceed its1.5s slack without a new CI allowance. Conversely a fast run may fit3500 even with some incorrect extra allowance; wall time is indirect evidence.

Historical/current relation: exact ship_ci_budget, wait_for_ship_ci and this terminal test function are byte-identical at measured3cbb90b0c94e0e748bbfc4eb1f75d7f9c2125c68 and current54c. Function hashes respectively ca06b8fa3813e4b25a611f44388029a2e4209544accfde4b07cc1dfb3fe53bca / e9dc42dc584dfe585902d9b7ca63f51580bd62aa0ee8e6b408ca92b21da6b906 / 5ced5dcfb197631008cefaf6cc8b28193696bf98ebc949668f8795031af2a811. Source equivalence does not identify the old executable/build mode or reproduce its elapsed failure.

Smallest warranted follow-up is FIXTURE evidence repair, not a production budget change. Existing ci_gate tests ship_ci_budget_excludes_the_mandate_scan649 and exhausted_ship_budget_still_polls_ci_once584 already provide pure duration and counting-FakeForge seams. Add explicit2s cases with synthetic elapsed ownership+preflight and separately excluded scan: exhausted=>ZERO, partially consumed=>exact remainder, scan exclusion never replenishes consumed ownership, None retains unbounded semantics. Feed the computed ZERO into the ACTUAL wait_for_ship_ci fake-forge path; assert one registration/row read, pending timeout21 with real Build name and no second poll/merge, and retain zero-budget green/red cases. For end-to-end handoff coverage, expose/capture the actual forwarded timeout at the existing3281 invocation through a narrow injected test callback/port (no env authority/runtime switch), and assert it equals that exact remainder; then a renewed Some(2s) at the callsite fails structurally without depending on loaded scheduling. No new clock framework is necessary.

Retain the black-box ownership release/exit21/no-merge behavior and an independent bounded child watchdog. Do NOT merely raise3500, increase production --wait, alter per-test ceilings, add sleeps/retries, serialize away contention, or skip/ignore this case. Replace the misleading wall-time inference only with the stronger shared-budget/poll-count contract proof under normal owner/advisor disposition; startup/phase wall measurements can remain diagnostic, not invented deadline authority. No speculative production fix justified by present evidence. A specific subsequent actual forwarded-budget mismatch would justify bounded production rework, rather than inferring one from process elapsed.

Idempotence checks: exact AIDA search ownership_and_ci_share_one_wait_deadline and3500 yielded0; shared deadline found completed TASK1339/BUG2184 plus unrelated results, no exact new fixture repair. No duplicate requirement filed; advisor may route this narrowly if wanted.

STORY1853 operator amendment preserved: canonical2026-10-23T16:51:59.770862495Z/09:51MST replaces <=10min local wall acceptance with same nextest lanes/no serial cargo fallback/slowest-lane budget. The retained30:24 warm measurement is historical contention evidence, not failure of current AC2. Keep numeric observations and real test diagnostics; do not reopen completed STORY1853, rerun a full suite, or waive CI/per-test/coverage floors.

No PR review currently assigned; actual pushed TASK2346 review preempts. This bounded diagnosis ends here; no ongoing watch claim.
subject: Re 009d04d7: TASK1287 wall assertion vs actual shared budget
